exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: When you go shopping, do you prefer to pay for things in cash or by card? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you ever save money to buy special things? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Would you ever take a job which had low pay? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 5
exercises.prompt: Would winning a lot of money make a big difference to your life? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe an interesting discussion you had as part of your work or studies. You should say: what the subject of the discussion was who you discussed the subject with what opinions were expressed and explain why you found the discussion interesting.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Why is it good to discuss problems with other people?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you think that it's better to talk to friends and not family about problems?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Is it always a good idea to tell lots of people about a problem?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Which communication skills are most important when taking part in meetings with colleagues?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 7
exercises.prompt: What are the possible effects of poor written communication skills at work?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 8
exercises.prompt: What do you think will be the future impact of technology on communication in the workplace?
